title: "Hello Again"
description: "Computable AI is back after a long hiatus."
date: 2026-07-09
categories: [Miscellany]
---

The last post on this blog went up in December 2019. Then — as blogs
do — it went quiet.

We're back. The focus is the same as it was: machine intelligence,
explained carefully enough to internalize, from reinforcement learning
fundamentals to commentary on current research.

One thing has changed under the hood: new posts are published with
[Quarto](https://quarto.org), so articles can be written as plain
Markdown or as Jupyter notebooks with their code and output rendered
directly into the post.

More soon. If you want to follow along, there's an
[RSS feed](../../index.xml).
